scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Eh? Wwwaaaah--!
Y-you're--it's-it's--
It's a freakin' Bard!
D-don't come any closer!
I... I don't like you guys!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
誒？哇啊啊啊——！
你...你是...你是...
該死的詩人！
不...不要靠近我！
我...我不喜歡你們這種人！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Eh? Wwwaaaah--!
Y-you're--it's-it's--
It's a freakin' Minstrel!
D-don't come any closer!
I... I don't like you guys!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
誒？哇啊啊啊——！
你...你是...你是...
該死的宮廷樂師！
不...不要靠近我！
我...我不喜歡你們這種人！

scripts.text: Wha--? Why the heck not?
scripts.translation: 什...？為什麼不行？

scripts.text: Hey, take it easy, man.
scripts.translation: 嘿，冷靜點，兄弟

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
N-no! Don't look at me!
I know what you're trying
to do! Please, I haven't
done anything to you!
J-just s-stay away!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
不...不要看我！
我知道你想幹什麼！求求你，我什麼也沒做啊！
請...請離我遠點！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
I'm not really trying
to do anything. Why
don't you relax, and--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個...
我其實沒想做什麼。你放鬆一下，然後...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Relax?! Nobody believes me
when I tell them how dangerous
you guys are. You think you're
so smug with your funny jokes
and lovely songs, but I know
what kind of powers you have!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
放鬆？！我告訴別人你們有多危險，可沒人相信我。你們自以為很了不起，講著笑話唱著歌，但我清楚你們擁有怎樣的力量！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
N-no! Don't look at me!
I know what you're trying
to do! Please, I haven't
done anything to you!
J-just s-stay away!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
不...不要看我！
我知道你想幹什麼！求求你，我什麼也沒做啊！
請...請離我遠點！

scripts.text: Offer him a drink.
scripts.translation: 請他喝一杯

scripts.text: Reassure him that you're safe.
scripts.translation: 向他保證你是安全的

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look, I don't know what
you've got against me, but
you really need to relax.
Here, have a drink on me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
聽著，我不知道你為什麼對我有偏見，但你真的需要放鬆一下。來，我請客喝一杯。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Oh~! Isn't that
a Tropical Sograt?
That's my favorite
drink in all the world!
Thanks so--waitaminute.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
哦~！這不是熱帶的蘇克拉特嗎？
這可是我全世界最喜歡的飲料！
謝...謝...等等。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Oh~! Isn't that
a Tropical Sograt?
That's my favorite
drink in all the world!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
哦~！這不是熱帶的蘇克拉特嗎？
這可是我全世界最喜歡的飲料！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
This is some sort
of weird trick, isn't it?
And to think I almost
f-f-fell for it! P-please
j-just leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
這肯定是某種詭計，對吧？
沒想到我差點就...就上當了！請...請別纏著我！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Wait, I've seen you before.
And you brought me a drink
just like this one. You...
You d-didn't learn th-that
w-w-weird skill, d-did you?
Wait, no. You couldn't have...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
等等，我以前見過你。
你也給我帶過一樣的飲料。你...
你...你不會學了那種...那種奇怪的技能吧？
不對，不可能...你不可能...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, please~
You know, I think
that maybe you
worry too much.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀~
你知道嗎，我覺得你可能是想太多了。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
^333333*Gulp Gulp*^000000
Ahhhh~ Oh, you don't
understand how long I've
been wanting this drink!
It tastes so good, and
now I feel sooo relaxed...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
^333333*咕咚咕咚*^000000
啊~！你不知道我有多想喝這個！
味道真好，我現在感覺好...好放鬆...

scripts.text: See? I'm not dangerous at all~
scripts.translation: 看吧？我一點都不危險~

scripts.text: So what makes someone like me so scary?
scripts.translation: 那像我這樣的人為什麼這麼可怕呢？

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Hmmm... Maybe.
Maybe all of you Bards
and Minstrels aren't that
bad. But I can never forget
what that Bard did to me...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
嗯...也許吧。
也許你們所有詩人和宮廷樂師都沒那麼壞。但我永遠忘不了那個詩人對我做的事...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
It all started when I was
traveling through Umbala and
met a strange Bard who was
studying under the tutelage
of Puchuchartan, the Utan
Shaman of the village.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
一切都要從我在汶巴拉旅行時說起，我遇到了一個奇怪的詩人，他正在村裡烏坦薩滿普楚查爾坦的指導下學習。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
That Bard and I got along fairly well until he took me to Umbala's
Bungee Jump. He insisted that I jump at least once for the ''full
Umbala experience.'' I refused, seeing as they don't use bungees.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
我和那個詩人相處得還算融洽，直到他帶我去汶巴拉的高空彈跳。他堅持讓我至少跳一次，說是為了“完整的汶巴拉體驗”。我拒絕了，畢竟那裡用的不是真正的高空彈跳繩。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
The Bard seemed offended
and claimed it was perfectly
safe, and that only a few people
have died by jumping. Then, he
just... He gave me this intense look.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
詩人似乎很生氣，聲稱這非常安全，只有少數人因為跳下去而死亡。然後，他只是...他給了我一個非常強烈的眼神。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
His eyes seemed so full
of rage! I remember him
mumbling something, and
all of a sudden, I lost control
of my body! My arms and legs
were just moving on their own!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
他的眼睛裡充滿了怒火！我記得他嘟囔著什麼，突然之間，我失去了對身體的控制！我的四肢開始不由自主地動起來！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Before long, I found myself
struggling to keep myself from
leaping off that Bungee Jump.
But the more I resisted, the
more violently I'd flail toward
the edge. It was horrible!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
沒過多久，我發現自己拼命想要阻止自己跳下那個高空彈跳臺。但我越是抵抗，身體就越猛烈地朝邊緣掙扎。太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
That was the most terrifying
experience of my life! It was
bad enough that I risked my
life, but that feeling of not
having any control over your
body is so overwhelming!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
那是我一生中最恐怖的經歷！雖然冒著生命危險已經夠糟糕了，但那種無法控制自己身體的感覺真是令人窒息！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, you're saying
a Bard did this to you?
I've never heard of a song
or skill with that sort of effect before. That's really strange...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，你是說一個詩人對你做了這種事？
我從未聽說過有歌曲或技能能產生這種效果。這真的很奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Well, I've never heard
of that sort of power up
until I had to experience
it for myself. Oh, I can still
see that evil smile of his
in my nightmares...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
嗯，在我親身體驗之前，我也從未聽說過這種力量。哦，我甚至還能在噩夢中看到他那邪惡的笑容...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Anyway, thanks for that
drink, it really helped me
settle my nerves. But I must
warn you not to look for that
strange Bard. I'm sure he's really some sort of demon or something...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
總之，謝謝你的飲料，真的讓我放鬆了不少。但我必須警告你，不要去找那個奇怪的詩人。我確信他一定是某種惡魔之類的東西...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
But... If you really
want to attain that sort
of power, I can't really
stop you. Thankfully, nobody
has any idea of where he is~
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
但是...如果你真的想獲得那種力量，我也無法阻止你。幸運的是，沒人知道他在哪裡~

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Even if you could find that
Bard to get him to teach you
how he did that to me, I'm sure
he mentioned something about
being at least ^660000Job Level 40^000000 to
be able to handle that power...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
即使你能找到那個詩人，讓他教你他對我做的那些事，我確信他提到過，至少需要^660000職業等級40^000000才能駕馭那種力量...

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
^333333*Sigh*^000000 Well, maybe all Bards
and Minstrels aren't terrifying. But any Bard will remind me
of the one that I met during my
travels. Just thinking about
that time gives me goosebumps.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000嗯，也許並非所有詩人和宮廷樂師都很可怕。但任何詩人都讓我想起我在旅途中遇到的那個。光是想想那次經歷，我就渾身起雞皮疙瘩。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Eh...?! Um, th-that's
nice of y-you to offer,
but I'm p-pretty picky
about what I d-drink.
P-plus, I don't k-know
if I can t-trust you.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
呃...？嗯，謝...謝謝你的好意，但我對喝什麼很挑剔。而且，我不確定我是否信任你。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
I don't think there's
much that could get m-me
to ch-change my m-mind!
Well... Maybe if you brought
my favorite drink, Tropical
Sograt, I would reconsider...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
我覺得沒什麼能讓我改變主意！嗯...也許如果你帶我最喜歡的飲料，熱帶蘇克拉特，我會重新考慮...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry,
I won't hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心，我不會傷害你。

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Th-that's what th-they
all say, right before they
get into your mind and then
twist it as hard as they can!
J-just don't t-touch me!
...Ack! And stay away!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
他...他們總是這麼說，就在他們侵入你的思想，然後拼命扭曲它之前！別...別碰我！
...啊！離我遠點！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Th-that's what th-they
all say, right before they
get into your mind and then
twist it as hard as they can!
E-even if you d-don't have
that p-power, l-leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
他...他們總是這麼說，就在他們侵入你的思想，然後拼命扭曲它之前！即...即使你沒有那種力量，也請...請離我遠點！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Oh... Oh goodness.
Was that a Bard just
over there? Oh, I'm so
afraid of those guys!
And those Minstrels
are even worse!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
哦...天哪。
剛才那邊是不是有個詩人？哦，我好怕那些人！
還有那些宮廷樂師，更糟糕！

scripts.text:
[Timid Young Man]
Don't get me wrong, I love
songs and entertainment,
but you've got to understand!
Some of them have powers
that you wouldn't believe!
I... I've seen them myself!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的年輕人]
別誤會，我喜歡音樂和娛樂，但你必須理解！
他們中的一些人擁有你無法想像的力量！
我...我親眼見過！

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Geh heh heh~
Been making good use of
what I taught you? Just be
careful and don't use that skill recklessly. Otherwise, people
will hate you as they hate me.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嘿嘿嘿~
你好好利用我教你的東西了嗎？只要小心點，別亂用那個技能。否則，人們會像恨我一樣恨你。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Your enemies, and the
occasional drunkard, on
the other hand, are different
matters entirely! Bwah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
至於你的敵人，還有偶爾遇到的酒鬼，那就完全是另一回事了！哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Impossible! You forgot
everything I've taught you?
How can that be? Oh well, it's
no trouble for me to teach that
to you again if you'd like.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
不可能！你把我教你的都忘了？
怎麼會這樣？好吧，如果你願意的話，我再教你一次也不麻煩。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Thanks, I'd appreciate that.
scripts.translation: 謝謝，我很感激

scripts.text:
[Riott]
What...?
You really don't
want to learn it?
I assure you there's
no strings attached.
If you change your mind...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
什...？
你真的不想學嗎？
我向你保證，沒有任何附加條件。
如果你改變主意...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
First, you must stare
fiercely into the eyes of
your target, and focus on
thoughts of dominance. This
is the basis for mesmerization. Now listen to this incantation...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
首先，你必須兇猛地凝視目標的眼睛，並專注於支配的想法。這是催眠的基礎。
現在，聽好這段咒語...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Uuuummm Baaalaaaa
Uuuummmm Baaalaaa~
Kkkkuuurrirrreeee
Kkkkuuurrirrreeee
Oooumm guandlejdl
Woooo Ei ei ei ei......
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
Uuuummm Baaalaaaa
Uuuummmm Baaalaaa~
Kkkkuuurrirrreeee
Kkkkuuurrirrreeee
Oooumm guandlejdl
Woooo Ei ei ei ei......

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Pang's Voice is used to
confuse people and disrupt
control of their bodies. It's not a fatal skill, but it is effective
in mentally upsetting your enemy. Make very wise use of this skill.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
陣痛之聲用於迷惑他人，並擾亂其身體的控制。
這不是致命技能，但在精神上擾亂敵人方面非常有效。
請明智地使用這個技能。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Ah, you've brought me
a Munak Doll made by
Yao Jun, just like you said
you would. Ah yes, this is her
craftsmanship, impeccable
as always. You've done well~
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
啊，你帶來了妖君製作的殭屍娃娃，就像你說的那樣。啊是的，這是她的工藝，一如既往地完美。你做得很好~

scripts.text:
[Riott]
To fulfill my part of this
bargain, I shall now teach
you my special skill. Now,
I developed this by listening
to incantations by the Utan
Shaman in Umbala.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
為了履行我在這筆交易中的部分，我現在將教你我的特殊技能。
我是通過聆聽汶巴拉的烏坦薩滿的咒語開發出來的。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
First, you must stare
fiercely into the eyes of
your target, and focus on
thoughts of dominance. This
is the basis for mesmerization. Now listen to this incantation...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
首先，你必須兇猛地凝視目標的眼睛，並專注於支配的想法。這是催眠的基礎。
現在，聽好這段咒語...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
''Toad's leg, Verit's heart,
spinning stars, spilling zeny,
hands and feet tied. Is this
voices yours, is this voice
mine. Head spinning, head
spinning, head spinning...!''
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
“蛙王的腿，畢萊特的心臟，旋轉的星星，灑落的Zeny，手腳被綁住。這是你的聲音，還是我的聲音。
頭暈，頭暈，頭暈...！”

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Remember, it doesn't matter
what you say, but how you say
it. Hypnotically induce your
target with a forbiddenly
seductive rhythm and your
grasp will be inescapable!
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
記住，重要的不是你說什麼，而是你怎麼說。
用禁忌的誘惑節奏催眠你的目標，你的掌控將無懈可擊！

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Ah, and use sleight of
hand to distract your target
from your true motive! I find
that casting Unbarring Octave
with this skill works best. This skill's name is ''Pang Voice!''
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
啊，還要用障眼法分散目標的注意力，使其偏離你的真實動機！我發現用這個技能施放冷笑話效果最好。
這個技能的名字叫“陣痛之聲！”

scripts.text:
[Riott]
''Pang Voice'' will mentally
shock your target and disrupt
control of his own body for
a while. You can't exert control
over victims with this skill, but they usually assume otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
“陣痛之聲”會在精神上衝擊目標，並暫時擾亂其對自己身體的控制。
你不能用這個技能控制受害者，但他們通常會這麼認為...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
You need to be judicious in
your use of this skill! Don't
use it recklessly, or people
will come to hate you as they
hate me. But ''Pang Voice'' can be welcome is certain situations.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
你需要謹慎地使用這個技能！
不要亂用，否則人們會像恨我一樣恨你。
不過在某些情況下，“陣痛之聲”還是很受歡迎的。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Subject your enemies to
Pang Voice as much as you
like, and no one will blame
you for it. And you can get away with casting Pang Voice on bullies
and drunkards occasionally...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
你可以隨意對敵人使用陣痛之聲，沒有人會責怪你。而且你偶爾可以對惡霸和酒鬼使用陣痛之聲...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hmpf. Weren't able
to find me a Munak Doll
yet? Well, don't worry, I'm
a patient man. Just try to get
one for me as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
哼。還沒找到殭屍娃娃嗎？
好吧，別擔心，我是個有耐心的人。
儘快給我弄一個吧。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Ah, you've brought me
some fresh eggs laid by
Yhelle, just like I asked.
I'm sure it was dangerous
going to Niflheim, but the flavor of these eggs is worth it.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
啊，你帶來了伊蕾爾新下的蛋，就像我要求的那樣。我相信去尼弗海姆很危險，但這些蛋的味道值得。

bargain, I shall now teach
you my special skill. Now,
I developed this by listening

Shaman in Umbala.

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hmm... You didn't
bring enough Eggs...
This will not do. It'll
be a while until Yhelle
will be able to lay more
eggs. Yes, this isn't enough...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嗯...你帶的蛋不夠...
這可不行。伊蕾爾需要一段時間才能下更多的蛋。
是的，這不夠...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Well, to make up for the
missing eggs, go and get 
me ^4D4DFF1 Munak Doll^000000. I know that
Yao Jun's Munak Dolls are
masterpieces, and I am an
an avid collector of her work.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
好吧，為了彌補缺少的蛋，去給我弄^4D4DFF1個殭屍娃娃^000000。
我知道妖君的殭屍娃娃是傑作，我是她作品的狂熱收藏家。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
In the meanwhile,
I'll enjoy the few
eggs that you do have!
Bweh heh heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
在此期間，我會享用你帶來的幾個蛋！
哇嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text: [Riott]
scripts.translation: [里奧特]

scripts.text:
[Riott]
So have you been
having trouble gathering
eggs from Yhelle? I know
she can be one fast running
chicken. But to survive where
she roosts, she has to be.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
所以，你在收集伊蕾爾的蛋時遇到麻煩了嗎？
我知道她跑得飛快。
但為了在棲息地生存下來，她不得不如此。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hmmrmpf!
Eh heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
哼哼！
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
What's so funny?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...
有什麼好笑的？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? Ah! That's one of the
Black Seals that can only
be given by Kino Kitty. You
must be a person of great
emotional depth if he favors
you enough to give you that.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嗯？啊！那是基諾·基蒂才能給予的黑色海豹寶寶。
如果你能得到它的青睞，說明你有著豐富的情感深度。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? Ah! That's one of the
Silver Seals that can only
be given by Errende. You
must be truly kind at heart
if he has offered to be your
friend. How about that?
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嗯？啊！那是艾倫德才能給予的銀色海豹寶寶。
如果你能得到它的青睞，說明你心地善良。真是不錯呢。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Geh heh heh~
Hey, take a look
at those two drunks
all the way over there.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嘿嘿嘿~
嘿，看看那邊那兩個醉漢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah, I can see them.
But what's so special
about those two guys?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我看到了。
但那兩個人有什麼特別的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Just...
Keep watching.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
只要...
繼續看著就好。

scripts.text:
^3355FFRiott stared intensely
at one of the drunken men
and began to harshly murmur
some indistinct words in a
low, hoarse voice. One of the
men starts slightly convulsing.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF里奧特死死地盯著其中一個醉漢，開始用低沉沙啞的聲音含糊不清地低聲咒罵。
其中一個男人開始輕微抽搐。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Bit Drunken Guy]
H-hey...! ^333333*Hiccup!*^000000
What are you doing?!
K-keep your hands to
yourself! Do I look
like a woman to you?
scripts.translation:
[有點醉的傢伙]
嘿...！^333333*打嗝！*^000000
你在幹什麼？！
把手拿開！
我看起來像女人嗎？

scripts.text:
[More Drunken Guy]
What are you talking
about? Wh-what?! Why
are my arms all wrapped
around you? S-sorry, I was
trying to just go that w--
I wasn't trying to hug you!
scripts.translation:
[更醉的傢伙]
你在說什麼？什...什麼？！
為什麼我的手臂都纏在你身上了？
對...對不起，我只是想走那邊--
我不是想抱你！

scripts.text:
[Little Bit Drunken Guy]
Bumping into me,
I understand. But a full
blown hug? Come on, now!
That was totally on purpose!
Wh-what? My h-hand! It's...
It's moving my itself?!
scripts.translation:
[有點醉的傢伙]
撞到我，我理解。
但完全擁抱？
拜託！
那絕對是故意的！
什...什麼？我的手！
它...
它在自己動？！

scripts.text:
[More Drunken Guy]
Ack! Wh-what are
you doing! S-stop
touching my butt!
scripts.translation:
[更醉的傢伙]
啊！你...你在幹什麼！
停...停下！
別摸我的屁股！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe two men continued
to gesticulate and move
wildly without direction.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF兩個男人繼續毫無方向地瘋狂地揮舞手臂和身體。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Those two...
Those two probably
had way too much to drink.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那兩個人...
那兩個人肯定喝得太多了。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Nah, they just lost
control of their bodies
for a bit. It's the result
of my skill which sort of
scrambles their minds.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
不，他們只是暫時失去了對身體的控制。
這是我的技能擾亂了他們心智的結果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mind scrambling?
Wait, are you the same
Bard who made someone
jump off Umbala's Bungee
Jump against his will?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
擾亂心智？
等等，你是那個讓某人違背意願從汶巴拉的高空彈跳跳下去的詩人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Huh? How did you
learn about that?
I'm not proud of that,
(even though it was
hilarious at the time)
but yeah, that was me.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
哈？你是怎麼知道那件事的？
我並不為此感到自豪（雖然當時確實很搞笑），但沒錯，那就是我。

scripts.text: Please teach me that skill!
scripts.translation: 請教我那個技能！

scripts.text: Oh, alright. Just checking.
scripts.translation: 哦，好的。只是隨便問問

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? You want to learn
how to scramble minds
like I did just now? Well,
I invented this skill, though
I did have a lot of help from
the Utan Shaman. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嗯？你想學我剛才那樣擾亂心智的技巧嗎？好吧，這個技能是我發明的，雖然我也得到了烏坦薩滿的很多幫助。讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Alright. If you want me
to teach you, then bring me
5 Eggs from a chicken named
Yhelle. Yhelle lays the highest
quality eggs: they're delicious
and great for a Bard's voice~
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
好吧。如果你想讓我教你，那就給我帶5個母雞伊蕾爾下的蛋。伊蕾爾下的蛋品質最高：既美味，又對詩人的嗓音有益~

scripts.text:
[Riott]
However, this chicken roosts
in a strange, dangerous place.
You'll need to explore this huge, mysterious tree in Umbala in order
to get there. Last time I went,
I pretty much almost died.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
不過，這隻雞棲息在一個奇怪又危險的地方。你需要探索汶巴拉那棵巨大而神秘的樹才能到達那裡。上次我去的時候，差點就死在那裡了。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Alright...
So don't forget
to come back here
and bring me back
^4D4DFF5 Yhelle's Eggs^000000, alright?
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
好了...
別忘了回來這裡，把^4D4DFF5個伊蕾爾的蛋^000000帶給我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Boy, you're a curious one.
But if you know about that
and you bumped into me, you
must certainly travel around
a lot. I can respect a good,
seasoned adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
哇，你還挺好奇的。
但既然你知道那些事，又碰巧遇到我，那你一定經常四處旅行。
我很尊重像你這樣經驗豐富的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wha...?
I can't believe you.
Mind scrambling? That
doesn't make any sense!
They're just really drunk...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...？
我真不敢相信你。
擾亂心智？那根本說不通！
他們只是喝得太醉了...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
How dare you question my
power? Oh well, I suppose
I really can't be too angry.
Most people who do believe
me usually claim that I'm
an axis of evil about now...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
你竟敢質疑我的力量？
算了，我想我也不能太生氣。
大多數相信我的人，通常都會說我是邪惡的化身...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Eh, nothing much. Say,
you don't have any Bard
Seals? That's a sure sign
that you haven't been really
connecting with the Bard
community. That's a shame...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嗯，沒什麼特別的。對了，你身上沒有詩人印章吧？
這說明你並沒有真正融入詩人圈子。真可惜...

scripts.text:
[Riott]
*Sigh* Alright, I know
how you can meet more Bards.
Why don't you try making friends with Errende? Look for a Bard
dressed in green in Geffen and
you should be able to find him.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
*嘆氣* 好吧，我知道怎麼讓你認識更多詩人。
為什麼不試著和艾倫德交朋友呢？
在吉芬找一個穿綠色衣服的詩人，你應該就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hmmrmpf!
Eh heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
哼哼！
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
What's so funny?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...
有什麼好笑的？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? Ah! That's one of the
Black Seals that can only
be given by Kino Kitty. You
must be a person of great
emotional depth if he favors
you enough to give you that.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嗯？啊！那是基諾·基蒂才能給予的黑色海豹寶寶。
如果你能得到它的青睞，說明你有著豐富的情感深度。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Hm? Ah! That's one of the
Silver Seals that can only
be given by Errende. You
must be truly kind at heart
if he has offered to be your
friend. How about that?
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嗯？啊！那是艾倫德才能給予的銀色海豹寶寶。
如果你能得到它的青睞，說明你心地善良。真是不錯呢。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Geh heh heh~
Hey, take a look
at those two drunks
all the way over there.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嘿嘿嘿~
嘿，看看那邊那兩個醉漢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah, I can see
together. But what
about them?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我能理解。但那些人呢？

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Just...
Keep watching.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
只要...
繼續看著就好。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Eh, nothing much. Say,
I notice you don't have
any Bard seals. That tells
me that you don't really
meet that many Bards. You
should really change that.
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
嗯，沒什麼特別的。對了，我注意到你身上沒有詩人印章。這說明你並沒有真正認識很多詩人。你應該改變一下這種情況。

scripts.text:
[Riott]
Bards and Minstrels can
make some pretty handy
friends if you give them
a chance. Here, why don't
you find Errende in Geffen?
He's a pretty popular guy...
scripts.translation:
[里奧特]
詩人和宮廷樂師如果給他們機會，會成為很得力的朋友。
對了，你何不去吉芬找艾倫德呢？
他是個很受歡迎的人...

scripts.text:
[Hen Yhelle]
Cluck-Cluuuck?
Cluck cluck cluck!
scripts.translation:
[母雞伊蕾爾]
咯咯-咯...？
咯咯咯咯！

scripts.text:
^3355FFUpon sensing your
presense, the hen
quickly ran away.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF感覺到你的存在，母雞迅速跑開了。^000000

Cluck-Cluuuck?
Cluck cluck cluck!
scripts.translation:
[母雞伊蕾爾]
咯咯-咯...？
咯咯咯咯！

Cluck-Cluuuck?
Cluck cluck cluck!
scripts.translation:
[母雞伊蕾爾]
咯咯-咯...？
咯咯咯咯！

scripts.text:
[Little Bit Drunken Guy]
What do you think
is the best drink in
all the world? I think
the Tri-- Tristan? What
was it called again?
scripts.translation:
[有點醉的傢伙]
你覺得世界上最好的酒是什麼？我覺得是特...特里斯坦？
叫什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[More Drunken Guy]
Oh! 13 Year Old Tristan?
That's a great drink, sure,
but it's way too expensive for
anything less than a special
occasion. ^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Personally,
I really like Ver... Uh, Ver...
scripts.translation:
[更醉的傢伙]
哦！13年陳特里斯坦？
那確實是好酒，但除非是特殊場合，否則太貴了。^333333*打嗝*^000000我個人我真的很喜歡維...呃，維...

scripts.text:
[Little Bit Drunken Guy]
Vermilion on the Beach?
Yeah, that's really good,
you'll pass out after just
having one shot! Yeah...
Tro... Tropical! People say
that's good too. Wait, what?
scripts.translation:
[有點醉的傢伙]
赤色海灘？
對，那真的很好，喝一口就會醉倒！是的...
熱...熱帶！人們說那個也不錯。等等，什麼？

scripts.text:
[Little Bit Drunken Guy]
H-hey...! ^333333*Hiccup!*^000000
What are you doing?!
K-keep your hands to
yourself! Do I look
like a woman to you?
scripts.translation:
[有點醉的傢伙]
嘿...！^333333*打嗝！*^000000
你在幹什麼？！
把手拿開！
我看起來像女人嗎？

scripts.text:
[More Drunken Guy]
What are you talking
about? Wh-what?! Why
are my arms all wrapped
around you? S-sorry, I was
trying to just go that w--
I wasn't trying to hug you!
scripts.translation:
[更醉的傢伙]
你在說什麼？什...什麼？！
為什麼我的手臂都纏在你身上了？
對...對不起，我只是想走那邊--
我不是想抱你！

scripts.text:
[Little Bit Drunken Guy]
Bumping into me,
I understand. But a full
blown hug? Come on, now!
That was totally on purpose!
Wh-what? My h-hand! It's...
It's moving my itself?!
scripts.translation:
[有點醉的傢伙]
撞到我，我理解。
但完全擁抱？
拜託！
那絕對是故意的！
什...什麼？我的手！
它...
它在自己動？！

scripts.text:
[More Drunken Guy]
Ack! Wh-what are
you doing! S-stop
touching my butt!
scripts.translation:
[更醉的傢伙]
啊！你...你在幹什麼！
停...停下！
別摸我的屁股！

scripts.text:
^3355FFA Bard in the room
watches the two drunk
men intently and giggles
at their stupor. Remember:
drinking too much isn't good!^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
So what would
you like to order?
scripts.translation:
[調酒師]
那麼，您想點什麼？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 熱帶的蘇克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海灘

scripts.text: Nothing, thanks.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
You sure you can carry
any more stuff with you?
Damn, it doesn't look that
way to me. Take a load off,
and put some stuff with in
your Kafra Storage, alright?
scripts.translation:
[調酒師]
您確定還能再帶更多東西嗎？
我看您好像快撐不住了。
卸下一些負擔，把東西存到卡普拉倉庫裡，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
 You sure you can afford
this now? This drink's
1,000 zeny, so you better
check the cash you have
onhand. Eh, just come back
later when you have the money.
scripts.translation:
[調酒師]
您確定現在買得起嗎？
這杯酒要1,000 Zeny，最好檢查一下您手頭有多少錢。
呃，等您有錢了再回來吧。

scripts.text:

Here you are,
1 Tropical Sograt.
It tastes sweet and
mild, but if you're not
careful, you'll pass out
in no time flat. Take it easy.

給您，一杯熱帶的蘇克拉特。
它味道甜美溫和，但如果不注意，您會很快醉倒的。
請適量飲用。
